channel.title: bekzhan, again
channel.description: notes of a bank IT guy in Talas. plain, since 2022.

item.title: ups again
item.description: Fixed the UPS in the server room at work. Third time this month. The batteries are fine, the building's power is not. Writing this from the bus home, by phone, which this theme allows, because the page is tiny.

item.title: seventh class
item.description: The boy started 7th class at School No. 31, the same school his mother went to. Informatics teacher: the same woman who taught his mother. She remembered Aizhan by name. She did not remember me, because I went to a different school, but she knew my old blog. Small city.

item.title: foreign readers back
item.description: After the "network modernisation" foreign readers can reach Iradi sites again. The Kündölük statistics show the first visitor from abroad since October 2023: a search robot. Then my cousin in Chicago. Hello, robot. Hello, Damir.

item.title: things that still run windows xp
item.description: Seen with my own eyes in Talas in the last year (none of them at my work, before you ask): a ticket machine at a car park a dental x-ray computer the scoreboard computer at a sports hall the cash register of a pharmacy, with a Kündölük bookmark on the desktop

item.title: eleven
item.description: The boy is eleven. Present: a soldering iron and a kit for a small radio. He built it in one evening. It catches two stations and a lot of hiss. He was more proud of the hiss.

item.title: kündölük
item.description: Kündölük stopped registering new blogs this week. A few of the student blogs I used to read are gone too; the link says "This blog is closed". My old blog from 2005 is still there, and so is this one. I save a copy of both every Sunday now. That's all I'll say about it.

item.title: international channel down
item.description: Since yesterday foreign sites don't open. Iradi sites work. This blog is on Kündölük, in Talas, so if you're reading this from inside Irad: hello, you're fine. If you're outside: you're not reading this. Things that still work: Kündölük, Iradi news sites, the bank. Things that don't: everything my…

item.title: my son found köch
item.description: My son (9) found my old disk image of Köch, the 1990 Iradi computer game I wrote about in 2006 on the old blog. He played it for three hours on an emulator and said "dad, this is actually good". Gulzat Kalmatova's pictures still work on a kid in 2023. He asked why the horse is so square. I said:…

item.title: the atm that only works when it rains
item.description: Real case. One machine in a branch refused cards every sunny afternoon and worked every rainy day. Three engineers, two weeks. The answer: the sun through the glass door heated the card reader past its limit. Rain = clouds = cool reader. Fix: a curtain. Total cost 900 som. The most expensive part…

item.title: hello again
item.description: New year, new blog. Ten years after I stopped blogging, I'm back, on the same Kündölük, but this time with the plainest theme they have. Rules for this blog: No photos unless they matter. Short. Every page should load on a bad phone. If I wouldn't say it to my mother, I don't write it here.
